Definition: from the same as G901; profundity, i.e. (by implication) extent; (figuratively) mystery:--deep(-ness, things), depth.
BiblicalUsage: Bathos is depth, and it is the word for the deep water where Jesus tells Peter to launch out and let down his nets. It is also the word for the depth that cannot separate us from the love of God, for the depth of the riches of God's wisdom and knowledge that Paul cries out over, and for the depth of Christ's love that passes knowledge.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe depth is the Bible's measure for what cannot be measured, because the love of God has a depth no line can sound and a height no ladder can reach. Paul bows his knees so we can comprehend it, and I hold that the deep things of God are not hidden from us but given to us by His Spirit.
